scope: Current Godot UI, gateway and GameStore read all original natural-choice protocol vectors from the complete preregistered native matrix
input_inclusion: Every original render-vectors.jsonl row from every fixed hero and seed block; no outcome, candidate or capacity filtering
capture_condition: Every resolution with frame cap 30 and controlled response delay 0
validity: Original before snapshot through the product gateway with an actual scoped snapshot-read request context
Original candidate, visible active-card order and intended accept, skip or replacement
Actual UI input through window mouse motion, press and release
Complete outgoing ClientEnvelope headers and typed payload match the original native command
Complete product pending-command registration and no state change before the original authority frames
Every original after frame through the product gateway and GameStore
Exact native after pool and revision, pending command cleared, popup closed and visible label geometry
Sources and original vectors unchanged, normal engine shutdown and all raw output on G
choice_cost_measurement: Elapsed synthetic pointer and rendered-frame time from opening the actual pool entry to submitting the original choice; reported separately from native command CPU/wall and the controlled response delay
development_smoke: All rows in one original hero-seed input, en, 960x540, frame cap 30, delay 0; excluded from formal RENDER totals
